verdict.rationale: Carta's API docs confirm the underlying data model for this workflow: draft option grants require 'board consent and approval' before finalization (carta-docs-22), and FMV/409A valuation data is available to price grants compliantly (carta-docs-23, carta-docs-13, carta-docs-20). This implies the platform supports issuing 409A-priced options with board approval, but the evidence is API-reference level rather than a documented end-to-end founder-facing workflow, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation that a founder can complete this in one seamless flow. missing for 10: first-party product walkthrough of the founder-facing grant-issuance UI (not just API), independent user confirmation the board-approval-to-409A-strike flow works smoothly end-to-end.
